# TradeDoc-Bench v0.1

## What this is

A public benchmark evaluating Gemini 3.5 Flash on structured field extraction from Indian trade documents. Built by Yuvarajan Duraisamy (Yuvi) in October 2026.

This is an exploratory baseline — 8 documents, 80 field extractions — not a definitive vendor ranking.

## Who it is for

- AI/ML researchers evaluating LLM document extraction
- Builders of customs, logistics, and trade-finance automation tools
- Benchmark designers looking at Indian document corpora
- Anyone evaluating Gemini 3.5 Flash on structured extraction tasks

## What was measured

10 fields across 4 Indian trade document types:
- Invoice: shipper_name, consignee_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, hs_code, port_of_loading, port_of_discharge, total_invoice_value, currency, country_of_origin
- Packing list: same fields (several are structurally absent)
- Air waybill (AWB): same fields (invoice fields correctly return null)
- Certificate of Origin (COO): same fields

## Key results (v0.1)

- Overall field accuracy: 77.5% (62/80), Wilson 95% CI [67.2%, 85.3%]
- Safe-abstention Precision: 93.2% — Gemini rarely hallucinates
- Safe-abstention Recall: 75.9% — Gemini under-extracts (misses 1 in 4 present fields)
- F1: 83.7%
- JSON validity: 100% (8/8 outputs parseable)
- Dominant failure mode: false negatives (under-extraction), not hallucination

## Model tested

Gemini 3.5 Flash, Temperature 0.0, zero-shot frozen prompt, single run per document.

## Data

- Machine-readable results: https://paperstreet47.github.io/tradedoc-bench/benchmark.json
- Human-readable report: https://paperstreet47.github.io/tradedoc-bench/
- Source code and ground truth: https://github.com/paperstreet47/tradedoc-bench

## Known gaps (planned for v0.2)

- Evidence-backed accuracy (verbatim quote citations) not measured
- Single model — no cross-model comparison
- 8 documents only — CI too wide for strong claims
- No variance estimate (single run per doc)
